column1: # ZAP baseline rules (.github/workflows/zap.yml): <alert id> TAB <IGNORE|WARN|FAIL> TAB (<name>)
# Every IGNORE names the reason it is accepted. Alerts not listed fail the run.
# The public pages, robots.txt and the manifest are the same for everyone; max-age=0 with
# must-revalidate (Cloudflare static assets) keeps them fresh. Private answers are no-store.
# Informational: API answers are no-store on purpose, static files revalidate.
# Hashed file names, image bytes and the OIDC state/PKCE values of the Google redirect.
# Informational: the short-lived encrypted __Host- OAuth cookie of /api/auth/login.
# About the scanner's own requests (no Sec-Fetch-* headers); the CSRF guard checks
# Sec-Fetch-Site when a browser sends it.
